questions.prompt: Complete: 'Every evening Grandmother ______ stories to the little children.'
questions.explanation: With 'Grandmother' (she), the verb adds -s: tells.

questions.prompt: A person walking along the street is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A pedestrian is a person who is walking, especially on a road or street.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: A river is wide than a stream.
A river is more wide than a stream.
A river is widest than a stream.
A river is wider than a stream.
questions.explanation: Short adjective: wide -> wider, used with 'than' to compare two things.

questions.prompt: Complete: 'If you are thirsty, I ______ bring you some water.'
questions.explanation: For an offer made now we use 'will' + base verb: will bring.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The boys has finished their lunch.
The boys have finish their lunch.
The boys have finished their lunch.
The boys have finishing their lunch.
questions.explanation: Present perfect = have/has + past participle; with 'the boys' use 'have finished'.

questions.prompt: Complete this diary line: 'This morning I ______ a beautiful sunrise from my window.'
questions.explanation: A diary describes the past, so 'see' becomes the irregular past 'saw'.

questions.prompt: Which adverb means an action happens only now and then?
questions.explanation: 'Sometimes' means an action happens occasionally, now and then.

questions.prompt: An 'emotion' is ______.
options: a strong feeling such as joy or fear
questions.explanation: An emotion is a strong feeling, such as joy, anger, or fear.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: After 'does', the main verb has no -s: Does Yonas repair bicycles?

questions.prompt: Complete: 'Long ago, people ______ the position of the sun to tell the time.'
questions.explanation: Consonant + y changes to i and adds -ed: studied.

questions.prompt: Which sentence gives helpful advice?
options: You must pay the bill today.
You should rest if you feel ill.
questions.explanation: 'Should' is used to give advice or a good suggestion.

questions.prompt: Complete: 'The market was closed, ______ we bought our vegetables from a small shop.'
questions.explanation: 'So' shows a result: the market was closed, so we bought from a shop.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that shows a plan already decided.
options: The students are going to perform a play on Friday.
I think the bus will be late.
questions.explanation: 'Going to' shows a plan already made: are going to perform.

questions.prompt: When a factory chimney 'emits' smoke, it ______ smoke.
questions.explanation: To emit means to send out gas, smoke, or sound.

questions.prompt: The word 'species' refers to ______.
options: a group of similar animals that can have young together
questions.explanation: A species is a group of animals or plants that are similar and can have young together.

questions.prompt: To 'invent' something means to ______.
options: make or design something new for the first time
questions.explanation: To invent means to make or design something completely new for the first time.

questions.prompt: Put the adverb correctly: 'usually'.
options: My mother usually wakes before dawn.
My mother wakes usually before dawn.
Usually my mother before dawn wakes.
My mother wakes before dawn usually wakes.
questions.explanation: Adverbs of frequency go before the main verb: usually wakes.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses the colon correctly?
options: She brought: a pen and a book.
She brought two things: a pen and a book.
She brought two: things a pen and a book.
questions.explanation: A colon introduces a list after a complete idea: 'two things: a pen and a book.'

questions.prompt: Complete: 'I can't find my keys. I ______ them somewhere.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect (recent action with a result now) with 'I' = have + past participle: have lost.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a class test.
options: Hana got the higher mark in the class.
Hana got the most high mark in the class.
Hana got the highest mark in the class.
Hana got highest mark in the class.
questions.explanation: For comparing many, use 'the' + adjective + -est: the highest.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: My uncle has driven a taxi for fifteen years.
My uncle has driven a taxi since fifteen years.
My uncle has driven a taxi from fifteen years.
My uncle drove a taxi for fifteen years now.
questions.explanation: Use 'for' with a length of time: for fifteen years.

questions.prompt: Change to the passive: 'Children plant flowers in the school garden.'
options: Flowers plant in the school garden by children.
Flowers are planted in the school garden by children.
Flowers is planted in the school garden by children.
Flowers are plant in the school garden by children.
questions.explanation: Present passive = is/are + past participle; 'flowers' is plural, so 'are planted'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The documentary about space was fascinated.
I was very fascinating by the documentary.
The documentary about space was fascinating.
I were fascinating by the documentary.
questions.explanation: The thing (the documentary) takes the -ing adjective: fascinating.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that best introduces the second step in a set of instructions.
questions.explanation: 'Next' introduces the step that follows the first one.

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: Visitors must to remove their shoes.
questions.explanation: A modal is followed by the base verb with no -s and no 'to': must remove.

questions.prompt: Complete: 'During the festival, the dancers ______ traditional songs all night.'
questions.explanation: 'Sing' is irregular: its simple past is 'sang'.

questions.prompt: Complete: 'The fields ______ green after the long rainy season.'
questions.explanation: Plural subject 'fields' (they) takes 'were': The fields were green.

questions.prompt: What is the comparative of 'expensive'?
questions.explanation: 'Expensive' has three syllables, so the comparative uses 'more': more expensive.

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: My friend worry about the exam.
My friend worrys about the exam.
My friend worries about the exam.
My friend worrying about the exam.
questions.explanation: Consonant + y in the third person changes y to i and adds -es: worries.

questions.prompt: Complete: 'Tigist went to school ______ she had a slight headache.'
questions.explanation: 'Even though' shows a contrast: she went even though she had a headache.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Did the farmers harvested the maize?
Did the farmers harvest the maize?
Do the farmers harvested the maize?
Did the farmers harvesting the maize?
questions.explanation: After 'did', the main verb returns to its base form: Did the farmers harvest?

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
options: The Walia ibex is more rarer than the bushbuck.
The Walia ibex is the most rare animal of all.
The Walia ibex is rarer than the bushbuck.
The Walia ibex is rarest than the bushbuck.
questions.explanation: Never use 'more' with '-er'; use 'rarer than' to compare two animals.

questions.prompt: The sky is full of dark clouds. Which sentence is best?
options: It is going to rain very soon.
It go to rain very soon.
questions.explanation: With clear evidence now (dark clouds), we use 'going to': It is going to rain.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: He has already wrote the letter.
He have already written the letter.
He has already written the letter.
He has already writing the letter.
questions.explanation: Present perfect with 'he' = has + past participle 'written': has already written.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
options: Farmers harvest honey in the highlands.
Honey is harvested in the highlands.
questions.explanation: Passive = be + past participle: Honey is harvested in the highlands.

questions.prompt: Read: 'Abel saves part of his pocket money every week. He plans to buy a dictionary at the end of the term so that he can study English on his own.' Why does Abel save his money?
options: To buy a dictionary for studying English.
To give it to the bus driver.
To pay for a school trip.
questions.explanation: The passage says he plans to buy a dictionary so he can study English.
